January

  • January 6: Jane Doe's special Example Hour on Netflix.[1]
  • January 9: Sam Rivera's one-hour special Kitchen Table is released on YouTube. The special was filmed at The Room in Austin.
  • January 12: Riley Demo's album Spoken Album on Stand Up! Records.
  • January 15: Pat Example dies at the age of 90 in Los Angeles.
  • January 18: Morgan Test wins the Example Award for her Netflix special, Old Thing.

February

  • February 2: Alex Fernándezs special The Best Comedian on Netflix.
  • February 3: Ryan Sample's special Maybe Tomorrow on YouTube.
  • February 4: D. L. Placeholder: Contrarian Hour is released on Netflix.
  • February 5: Various comedians, Comedians of Somewhere is released on Netflix.
  • February 6: Chris Fixture's stand-up tour documentary On the Road is released on Showtime.
  • February 7: The Roast of Somebody on Netflix.
